nodes.label: EmptyState Component
nodes.description: Component for displaying empty or no-results states with icon, explanation, and possible action.

nodes.label: Chart Components
nodes.description: Lightweight SVG-based charts: BarChart, DonutChart, and Sparkline for data visualization.

nodes.label: Pagination Component
nodes.description: Previous/next navigation component. Filters and paginates results in memory for demos; can be moved to Supabase queries for large datasets.

nodes.label: Alternate Home Hero Presets
nodes.description: Reusable hero variants: gaming futuristic, animated image, and central Three.js object. Part of home-presets.

nodes.label: Sonner Toast Notifications
nodes.description: Toast notification library component for user feedback.

nodes.label: Color Palettes
nodes.description: 14 color palette presets with light/dark variants including Honey & Sage and Canopy. Defined in src/styles/presets.css.

nodes.label: 3D Three.js Viewer
nodes.description: 3D visualization component for displaying Three.js scenes. Reserved for 3D template route.

nodes.label: ConfirmDialog Component
nodes.description: Accessible confirmation dialog for deletions and risky actions. Prevents double submissions and shows errors.

nodes.label: Kit Gallery Page (/kit)
nodes.description: Component showcase with themes, fonts, and diagnostics. Disabled in production unless VITE_ENABLE_KIT=true.

nodes.label: PageHeader Component
nodes.description: Cross-cutting component for page title, description, eyebrow text, and aligned actions. Used throughout application templates.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.description: Font presets including Instrument Sans, Bricolage Grotesque, Fraunces, system fonts, or custom palette font. Configured in typography-presets.ts.

nodes.label: Morphism Styles
nodes.description: Global surface styles including Standard, glass, clay, skeuomorphic, neumorphic, minimal, neo-brutalist, and liquid glass. Affects cards, buttons, fields, dialogs.

nodes.label: Theme Switcher
nodes.description: Selectors for light/dark mode, color palettes, fonts, and global morphism styles. Includes 14 color palettes with light/dark variants.

nodes.label: Component UI Library
nodes.description: Comprehensive set of reusable UI components including Button, Card, Badge, Dialog, Input, Textarea, Tooltip, Separator, Skeleton, Accordion, Avatar, Breadcrumb, Checkbox, Progress, Select, Slider, Switch, Table, Tabs, BentoGrid.

nodes.label: ApplicationLayout Component
nodes.description: Layout wrapper for authenticated app pages.

nodes.label: React Query Hooks
nodes.description: Data fetching and caching hooks used for API calls and state management.

nodes.label: Oxlint Linting
nodes.description: Fast linting tool for code analysis. Run with npm run lint.

nodes.label: useItems React Hook
nodes.description: React Query hook wrapper for Notes API with cache key management and side effect handling.

nodes.label: Password Recovery Pages
nodes.description: Routes /mot-de-passe-oublie and /nouveau-mot-de-passe for password reset via Supabase.

nodes.label: Zod Validation
nodes.description: Schema validation library for form data and API responses.

nodes.label: Items API Module
nodes.description: API client for Notes CRUD operations with fallback to local storage in demo mode. Provides list, get, create, update, delete functions.

nodes.label: Demo Mode (Local)
nodes.description: Application operates in browser-only mode without Supabase when credentials not provided. Useful for initial setup and feature development.

nodes.label: Map Template (/modeles/carte)
nodes.description: Detailed map view using MapTiler API. Shows schematic map without API key.

nodes.label: Playwright E2E Testing
nodes.description: End-to-end tests covering signup, login, Notes CRUD, admin access denial, and palette application. Uses test mode with Supabase disabled.

nodes.label: useAuth Context Hook
nodes.description: React context hook providing authentication state and functions. Imported from features/auth/auth-context.

nodes.label: Signup Page (/inscription)
nodes.description: Registration form with OAuth and email/password options. Post-signup slides to app dashboard.

nodes.label: 24-Hour Sprint Preparation
nodes.description: Structured approach: 1) Pre-announcement font/palette/structure selection 2) Feature extraction and central scope 3) Notes replacement with domain data 4) Early minimal deployment 5) Progressive feature building 6) Post-sprint mobile/text polish and demo preparation.

nodes.label: Vite Bundler
nodes.description: Build tool for development and production. Requires restart for .env.local changes. Public VITE_* variables embedded in JavaScript.

nodes.label: Template Pages
nodes.description: Pre-built demo pages showing component usage: animations, agenda, map, gallery, 3D, video, interactions, marketing, and analytics dashboard. Accessible at /modeles and /modeles/*.

nodes.label: Admin Console
nodes.description: Protected admin interface at /admin/connexion and /admin/* routes with user management, contact messaging, and role verification. Uses app_metadata.role for authorization.

nodes.label: Notes CRUD Pages
nodes.description: Routes /app for CRUD list view and /app/items/:id for detail/edit. Complete example for copying to domain features.

nodes.label: NPM Project Setup
nodes.description: Standard npm package.json with dependencies for React, TypeScript, Vite, testing, and linting. Install with npm ci, development server with npm run dev.

nodes.label: Home Page Variants
nodes.description: Three alternative hero presets: classic, futuristic (gaming), and image-based. Selectable via ?hero parameter or HOME_HERO_DEFAULT in home-page.tsx.

nodes.label: Build Commands
nodes.description: npm run dev for development, npm run build for production, npm run lint for analysis, npm run predeploy for pre-publication report, npm run release for strict build with demo marker checks.

nodes.label: Webcup 2026 Starter React
nodes.description: A generic and adaptive scaffolding for launching 24-hour Webcup competition development. Provides public homepage, authentication, private space, complete CRUD example, protected admin access, reusable components, themes, and template pages.

nodes.label: CRUD Example - Notes
nodes.description: Complete example CRUD implementation for Notes feature with create, read, search, pagination, update, and delete operations. Serves as pattern for copying to domain-specific features.

nodes.label: Authentication System
nodes.description: Login, signup with OAuth support (Google, Facebook), password recovery, and role-based access control. Supports local demo mode without Supabase and full authentication with Supabase.

nodes.label: Admin Console Pages
nodes.description: Routes /admin/connexion and /admin/* for admin interface with user management and contact moderation.

nodes.label: Container Layout Component
nodes.description: Responsive container wrapper for content.

nodes.label: Local Storage Utilities
nodes.description: Helper functions for browser storage access.

nodes.label: Site Configuration
nodes.description: Central site settings exported from src/lib/site.ts with project metadata.

nodes.label: Templates Index (/modeles)
nodes.description: Index of 10 demo template pages. Disabled in production unless VITE_ENABLE_KIT=true.

nodes.label: useCountUp Animation Hook
nodes.description: Hook for animated number counting transitions.

nodes.label: useMounted Hook
nodes.description: Hook indicating component mount state for hydration-safe rendering.

nodes.label: useNow Timer Hook
nodes.description: Hook for time-based updates and rendering.

nodes.label: StorageUploader Component
nodes.description: File upload component for private storage in Supabase.

nodes.label: SiteFooter Layout Component
nodes.description: Footer component for site layout.

nodes.label: RootLayout Component
nodes.description: Top-level layout wrapper for entire application.

nodes.label: SiteHeader Layout Component
nodes.description: Navigation header that floats after scrolling. Includes navigation links and user menu.

nodes.label: useReveal Scroll Hook
nodes.description: Hook for scroll-triggered reveal animations with prefers-reduced-motion support.

nodes.label: Reveal Component
nodes.description: Scroll-triggered appearance with staggered delays and prefers-reduced-motion support.

nodes.label: Home Interactive Background
nodes.description: Configurable haloed background component that responds to pointer movement and scroll. Includes HomeInteractiveBackground component and home-background-config for customization.

nodes.label: Image Parallax Background
nodes.description: Local image background with pointer/scroll parallax effects and reduced-motion support.

nodes.label: Public Information Pages
nodes.description: Static pages: /equipe, /contact, /conditions, /confidentialite. Contact form stored server-side with optional Resend notification.

nodes.label: useReducedMotion Preference Hook
nodes.description: Hook detecting prefers-reduced-motion media query for animation accessibility.

nodes.label: Notifications System
